predecessors.name: Samo's Empire
predecessors.text: 'A smaller part of the former March of the Slavs' that 'preserved independence' when Samo's tribal union disintegrated after his death in 658

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: Carantania, which 'finally became a margraviate of the Carolingian Empire' in 828, its internal autonomy abolished after the anti-Frankish rebellion of Ljudevit Posavski

ledger.x: c. 661: Carantania emerges from the ruins of Samo's tribal union. 'In 658 Samo died and his Tribal Union disintegrated'; 'The name Carantania itself begins to appear in historical sources soon after 660'; the page says only that it 'emerged in the second half of the 7th century'. 661 is Cliopatria's year; the infobox…

c. 743: Carantania becomes a vassal of Duke Odilo of Bavaria after its princes ask for help against the Avars. Duchy of Bavaria: 'At around 743, the Bavarian duke Odilo vassalised the Slavic princes of Carantania' who had asked him for protection against the invading Avars; Carantania page: 'When about 740 Prince…
788: the Bavarian overlordship of Carantania ends with the fall of Duke Tassilo III.
788: the Frankish kingdom becomes Carantania's sole overlord when Bavaria is taken over.
828: Carantania's tributary status ends as it is absorbed into the Carolingian Empire.
828: Carantania loses its autonomy and becomes a Carolingian margraviate.

wars.name: Carantanian-Avar conflict
wars.outcome: About 740 Boruth asks Duke Odilo of Bavaria for help against the Avars and Carantania loses its independence; the Avars 'had regained eastern parts of Carantania between 745 and 795'.

certainty.note: The page names regions (Carinthia, Styria, Lungau, Ennspongau) and no border line; the Avar frontier moved between 745 and 795 without a located line.
